title: Guidance from experienced leaders.
lead: Experienced leaders who guide our strategy and help us deliver greater value to our clients.

advisors.name: Dr. Wally Potts, Ed.D, MBA, PMP
bio: Dr. Potts advises and mentors Tech Transpire on technology strategy, enterprise transformation and operational excellence.

He brings 15+ years of enterprise technology and operations leadership across Fortune 50, federal, healthcare and private equity-backed organizations, including a $472M enterprise services portfolio at Leidos and 9,000+ applications migrated to hybrid cloud platforms at HP.
Most recently, he led M&A execution — due diligence, data room development and integration planning — for the sale of Veterans Engineering to Aretum, after scaling its backlog from $6M to $170M+.

advisors.name: Sanket Thakkar
bio: Sanket is a serial entrepreneur and the CEO & Co-Founder of IConflux Technologies, a software development company with a team of 100+ developers serving Fintech, Manufacturing, and Tech Startups globally. With over 13 years of building and scaling technology ventures, Sanket brings deep expertise in business growth, digital transformation, and POD-based delivery models. At Tech Transpire, he advises on growth strategy and market expansion.

advisors.name: Ketul Thakker
bio: Ketul advises and mentors the CEO of Tech Transpire on market positioning, marketing communications and campaign development. He helps translate Tech Transpire's delivery capabilities into clear client propositions and campaigns that reach the right audiences — refining messaging, guiding campaign design, and aligning marketing activity with business development priorities. Through ongoing collaboration with the CEO, he helps bring focus and consistency to how the company presents its services and pursues growth.

advisors.name: Saurabh Kumar
advisors.role: Technical Advisor — AI Strategy & Deep Tech
bio: Saurabh advises the CEO of Tech Transpire on AI strategy and deep technology. He helps shape how the firm evaluates emerging technologies, positions its technical offerings and wins clients in hard-tech markets. He also reviews client engagements hands-on where architecture, security or embedded systems decisions carry real risk.

A technology executive with 25+ years of experience, Saurabh was most recently Director and Principal Engineer at Samsung Research America. There he led a 25-person global R&D team across agentic AI, developer productivity and open source. He represented Samsung at board level in the Linux Foundation and the Agentic AI Foundation. He led the company's evaluation of AI coding agents through benchmarking and harness engineering, and briefed the CTO on adopting emerging technologies.

His AI advice rests on two decades of hardware work for some of the world's largest consumer electronics companies. At Marvell he did SoC firmware and silicon bring-up for Hisense, Vizio, Lenovo and TPVision. At Samsung SmartThings he shipped firmware to millions of hubs. He is active on the standards bodies behind the major smart home and low-power mesh protocols used in smart home and industrial applications. Through his consultancy, Wanderlight Creative Group, he designed a way to upgrade IoT devices already in the field to post-quantum cryptography with no new silicon.

advisors.name: Dharmendra Mistry
bio: Dharmendra advised Tech Transpire on healthcare operations and client delivery. A healthcare and medical technology executive with more than 30 years of experience, he built Biomet India from inception to about $10 million in four years, led the Zimmer Biomet integration in India, and headed Lumenis across India and South Asia. As co-founder of Valiant Care, he built and ran a 24/7 care service for seafarers, giving him first-hand experience of how clinical workflows really run. At Tech Transpire, he worked with hospitals and clinicians to find workflow gaps and turn them into clear requirements for the delivery team.
